titulo: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Ratko Mladić dies in Hague prison
cuerpo: The former Bosnian Serb military commander, sentenced to life for the summary execution of more than 8,000 Bosniaks in July 1995 and the years-long siege of Sarajevo, died at 84. He spent 15 years as a fugitive before his arrest in Serbia in 2011.
